comment: Manifest of green-registry blend candidates for the Track G3 green blend. Add a new source by appending ONE object to this list -- no code changes needed. See README.md 'Adding a new source' for the exact steps (registry_guard also needs a matching green_allowlist.json entry before optimize_blend.py will accept it).

sources.name: exp038_sigmafixed
sources.notes: current green champion. context_rows: 1, sigma_mode=fixed (no predicted-sigma head).

sources.name: exp040_metric
sources.notes: architecturally distinct 2nd model (metric_weight=0.6 tile-RMSE-shaped loss). Weaker solo but earmarked for blend diversity (Track G3).

sources.name: exp056
sources.notes: 2026-07-30 addition: from-scratch CompactUNet factorized-head champion architecture (seed42). Architecturally distinct from the exp064 pretrained-encoder family -- included for architecture-diverse ensembling with the new champion (round8 plan 2026-07-30 update, item (b)).

sources.name: exp064_effb3
sources.notes: 2026-07-30 addition: NEW green champion. timm efficientnet_b3 pretrained encoder + exp056's factorized decoder head. fold0/4 gate called this 'mixed' but full 5-fold LB beats the prior champion by -0.01076 -- the gate underestimated this axis.

sources.name: exp064_effv2s
sources.notes: 2026-07-30 addition: 2nd-best solo. timm tf_efficientnetv2_s pretrained encoder, same decoder head as exp064_effb3. Same encoder family as the champion -- lower ensembling-diversity value than exp056 or exp064_swin_lr2e4, but strong solo score.

sources.name: exp064_swin_lr2e4
sources.notes: 2026-07-30 addition: timm swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224 (transformer, architecturally most distinct from the EfficientNet-family champion -- highest ensembling-diversity value). fold0/4 gate-passed cleanly (best gate result since exp056, f0 0.27404/f4 0.58572), and confirmed on LB: solo 0.6704384663890527 (2026-07-30 16:04:15), beats exp064_effb3 by -0.00157. Got the highest nested_blend.py ensemble weight (0.315, tied with effb3) in exp065_champion_ensemble_causal, the new overall champion.

sources.name: exp064_pvt_v2_b0_lr2e4
sources.notes: 2026-08-01 addition: timm pvt_v2_b0 (Pyramid Vision Transformer v2), a new backbone family distinct from all 5 existing manifest members' families (from-scratch CNN, EfficientNet, EfficientNetV2, Swin). Solo LB is an effective tie with exp064_effb3 (+0.00053, within noise), but per this project's own precedent (swin_lr2e4 got the highest blend weight despite not being the best solo) architectural distinctness may still carry ensembling value -- included to test that.

sources.name: exp064_swin_small_lr2e4
sources.notes: 2026-08-01 addition: timm swin_small_patch4_window7_224, capacity scale-up of exp064_swin_lr2e4 (same transformer family, worse solo LB +0.00151 vs Tiny). Included mainly to check whether it adds anything on top of swin_lr2e4 already being in the manifest -- expect low/negative marginal value since it's the same family, not excluded a priori to let the outer-cross-fit decide.

sources.name: exp064_convnext_lr2e4
sources.notes: 2026-08-01 addition: timm convnext_tiny. Solo LB 0.6837550386507026 (2026-08-02) -- worst of the exp064 family, broke the 'smaller wins within family' pattern (worse than convnext_small). Blend contribution tested negligible (+7-way nested score only -0.00005 vs 6-way, avg weight 0.058) -- kept in manifest for completeness but not expected to move the blend.

sources.name: exp064_effb1
sources.notes: 2026-08-03 addition: timm efficientnet_b1, one size down from champion effb3, extending the 'smaller wins within EfficientNet' pattern (b3<b4) further down. 5-fold OOF 0.59934. Same encoder family as effb3/effv2s -- lower diversity value, included mainly as a possible solo/seed-style upgrade. No solo LB yet.

sources.name: exp064_effb2
sources.notes: 2026-08-03 addition: timm efficientnet_b2. 5-fold OOF 0.59693 -- BEATS exp064_effb3's own OOF (0.59758), 2nd-best OOF of any solo model tested this session (behind pvt_v2_b0's 0.59617). Strongest candidate to extend the EfficientNet capacity-down pattern into a real solo win. No solo LB yet -- same family as effb3/effv2s so lower ensembling-diversity value, but worth testing as a straight effb3 replacement.

sources.name: exp064_regnety016
sources.notes: 2026-08-03 addition: timm regnety_016 (RegNet-Y, new CNN family distinct from all 9 existing manifest members). 5-fold OOF 0.60025. fold0/4 gate was mixed (best fold0 of any candidate, -0.00808 vs effb3, but fold4 +0.00632 worse) -- same 'mixed' shape that historically underestimated effb3/effv2s. No solo LB yet; genuinely new architecture family so blend-diversity value is the primary interest regardless of solo outcome.

sources.name: exp064_densenet121
sources.notes: 2026-08-03 addition: timm densenet121 (DenseNet, new CNN family distinct from all 9 existing manifest members). 5-fold OOF 0.59990. fold0/4 gate was mixed (best fold0 of ALL candidates tested, -0.01007 vs effb3, but fold4 +0.00846 worse). No solo LB yet; genuinely new architecture family so blend-diversity value is the primary interest regardless of solo outcome.
